scope: One retained-photo bounded rigid-pose refinement pilot, not fresh reconstruction or the three-video benchmark
intervention: Only the second arm receives its candidate contour overlays and numeric residuals. Both arms receive identical original images, source masks, object/camera metadata and ordinary candidate renders.
model_execution: Two fresh local child agents with fork_turns=none, same inherited session model/settings; no remote Codex or paid API client
author_output: Declarative per-entity cumulative XY translation and yaw from shared initial state, with source-based justification; root applies and checks actions in isolated remote directories
primary_metric: Mean visible-mask IoU across the two frozen cabinet IDs at the final prescribed round
selection: Always evaluate prescribed round 2; no score-based extra turns, restart or best-round cherry-picking
missing_result: Retain failure and full two-object denominator; use existing geometry evaluator failure penalties
isolation: Disjoint output directories and explicit agent input restrictions; not OS-enforced sealed isolation
limitations: Source and masks are fitting observations
Coarse cabinet masks are close to saturation
Equal turns/render allowance is not equal token consumption
No whole-room visual or physical acceptance claim
